name: dsh-peak-whale
description: DeepSeek API peak/off-peak pricing awareness for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): current tariff with countdown, optional balance, and next half-price windows ready for schedule_create.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && node scripts/build-client.mjs
scripts.selfcheck: tsc src/pricing.ts src/render.ts src/client/card-model.ts --outDir .selfcheck --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --skipLibCheck && node scripts/selfcheck.mjs && node scripts/parse-check.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run check-dist && npm run selfcheck && npm run smoke && npm run client-check
